test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Sita made gulab jamuns.

options.text: Gulab jamuns was made by Sita.
Gulab jamuns were made by Sita.
Gulab jamun is made by Sita.

solution:
The correct answer is:** Gulab jamuns were made by Sita.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb '**made**' changes to '**were made**' in the passive voice (since "gulab jamuns" are plural).
 
• The **doer **of the action (**Sita**) is mentioned after the verb in the passive voice.
 
• The preposition '**by**' is used to show the doer of the action in the passive voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
